headline: Tempest Island Flares Anew as Stema Landing Goes Quiet
war_summary: Tempest Island leads this edition: Blackwatch, the isle's busiest post, saw action within the past two hours, the freshest event on any front, and the ledger now shows no work left in no-man's-land, the neutral ground returned to Colonial keeping. Stema Landing, our previous lead, has fallen silent, its last event more than three hours old, though The Wane logged six actions on the day and all nine works remain Colonial-held. Fishermen's Row still tops the day's ledger with twenty-three events, three inside six hours, its works standing eight Warden to one Colonial, Peripti Landing and Dankana Post drawing the busiest trade. Godcrofts counted nine actions over the day, Argosa the busiest, with all nine posts Warden-held. The Deadlands, eight hours without a base event, grind on regardless: casualties run near seven hundred an hour a side, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the contested posts, eight of eleven works Colonial-held. Farranac Coast filed three actions at Mara, while Linn of Mercy and the Weathered Expanse stay quiet on bases though their casualty tallies remain steep. This is the eighty-third day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
